focus_area_title: Develop a Habit of Appreciating Input
content_text_body:
Thanking your team members is one of the simplest and most effective ways to communicate that you value hearing their ideas, suggestions, and perspectives.

For starters, read this brief article to get the big picture: [Are You Using Recognition Effectively?](https://hbr.org/2008/02/are-you-using-recognition-effe-1)  

### For one week, just observe

Jot down all of the times that your team shared an idea, insights, perspective, or suggestion with you. Review the list at the end of each day.

### Practice every day

Consistently say "thank youâ€ for all your teams' efforts communicating their ideas. Create a trigger for yourself, for example:

*The first time I see each team member each day, I will thank them for their latest suggestion.*

Thank them. Let them know what they said, why it was important for the team and the business, and how you plan to follow up on an idea or suggestion. 

### Create a feedback loop

Ask your team to give you feedback at the end of each week on how consistently you're recognizing them for sharing ideas.
